representative_policy: Public full-coordinate examples are available for 16 of 16 assigned clusters. Trim-specific medoids, ensembles, TM grids and Bonsai are not available in these views.
mask_note: Clustering retains CDK2 A1–298 and DOC1 B60–115 (354 residues). DOC1 B1–59 is excluded from clustering. Coordinate downloads contain the original full construct.
clustering_method_note: HDBSCAN leaf uses a fresh 10D mask-specific UMAP (30 neighbors, min_dist 0) with seed 42, minimum cluster size 15 and minimum samples 11. Both cohorts were fit separately. The PCA variance refers to the masked distance sketch. Saved confidence, ProteinEBM and DockQ values describe their original full-construct scoring scope.

core_results.summary: Full → trimmed, HDBSCAN leaf: 12 → 16 clusters; 354 → 431 unassigned. 16/16 clusters in this view have a published structure example.
core_results.structures_note: Trim-specific medoids, aligned ensembles, TM grids and Bonsai are unavailable.
